comment: Maps PPC-spiral kernel IDs to the criterion bench-target / size leaves they will compare against. Pinned by jit:b2ecd2ff (session 2 of babcf05e) using `cargo bench --save-baseline ppc-v0-2026-04-27` against HEAD=52eaac8. The bench inventory under `crates/gf2-core/benches/` was swept end-to-end at pin time; pinned kernels reflect the full set of bench files extant at HEAD that map to a Tier-A/B/C/D kernel. Consumed by dev/benchmarks/ppc-compare.sh and the criterion-1.5x JIT gate via scripts/criterion-1.5x.sh; the gate is per-issue keyed by a `ppc-kernel:<id>` label (id is one of A1, A2, A3, B1, B2, B3, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, D1, D2). Path resolution: `$CRITERION_DIR/$bench_target/$size/$baseline_name/estimates.json` — `bench_target` may include slashes for nested groups (e.g., `gf2m_mul_crossover/pclmulqdq_barrett`), and `size` may be `.` for leaf benches with no parameter. Entries marked TBD-* have no current bench in `crates/gf2-core/benches/`; the kernel-implementing task is expected to add a dedicated bench before its first spiral edit. B1 was pinned in jit:1c1c4242 (V0 step) against the new `crates/gf2-core/benches/matrix_transpose.rs` bench. New benchmark leaves added after pinning, such as D2, may use `baseline_bench_target` for current-vs-current comparisons when that is the only apples-to-apples baseline.

A3.title: Generic Fp prime FieldVec batch dispatch (Solinas-friendly)

C1.title: GF(2^m) batch m=8/16/32 via VPCLMULQDQ
C1.amendment_note: Replaced bench_target `gf2m_mul_crossover/pclmulqdq_barrett` (single-shot per-element kernel) with the batch leaf `gf2m_mul_crossover/gf2m_batch_unroll4` and an apples-to-apples baseline leaf `gf2m_mul_crossover/pclmulqdq_barrett_loop_v0` (existing single-shot kernel called per-element in a tight loop over the same BATCH_SIZE=1024 inputs). Both leaves are produced by `bench_gf2m_batch_pclmulqdq_unroll4` in `crates/gf2-core/benches/gf2m_mul_strategies.rs`. ppc-compare.sh compares current-vs-current via `baseline_bench_target` rather than a saved-baseline lookup; pinning a saved baseline at the new leaf would not be apples-to-apples because the V0 path is also new (the old `pclmulqdq_barrett` leaf measured a different, single-multiplication workload).

C2.title: GF(2^571) multi-word VPCLMULQDQ
C2.rationale: C2's success criterion is the GF(2^571) size class. The earlier manifest entry still pointed at the pre-existing 4-limb raw-clmul leaf, so it measured an unchanged helper and reported 1.0x. The C2 implementation adds the m=571 dispatched and scalar Barrett leaves in `gf2m_wide_mul`; compare those current leaves apples-to-apples because the pinned ppc-v0 baseline did not contain the m=571 leaf.

C3.title: Fp prime Montgomery batch SIMD (AVX2)
C3.rationale: C3 measures a generic 64-bit Montgomery batch (P=M61_LIKE_GENERIC=2^61-45, neither Mersenne nor Proth), exercising the generic-Fp AVX2 kernel through gf2-kernels-simd::fp_generic::detect(). The previous M31 leaf measured the M31 specialised path, not the general Montgomery batch.

C4.title: QuadraticExt::mul Karatsuba SoA batched SIMD
C4.rationale: C4's SoA benchmark is defined as a current SoA-vs-AoS comparison: `batch_soa` excludes transposition cost for data already in SoA form, and `sequential_aos` calls the unchanged `QuadraticExt::mul` path. The pinned ppc-v0 saved-baseline leaf was unavailable/polluted for this new SoA path, so compare the two current leaves apples-to-apples.

C5.title: CubicExt::mul Karatsuba SoA batched SIMD
C5.rationale: C5's SoA benchmark mirrors C4: `batch_soa` excludes transposition cost for data already in SoA form, and `sequential_aos` calls the unchanged CubicExt::mul AoS path. The C5 bench leaf was added with the implementation, so compare the two current leaves apples-to-apples rather than a missing saved baseline.

D2.title: SparseBitMatrix Cuthill-McKee row reorder
D2.rationale: D2 adds this benchmark leaf, so compare current RCM against current CSR rather than a missing saved baseline. The optimized leaf keeps vectors and results in reordered coordinates after one-time RCM preprocessing; the separate `rcm_original_output` Criterion leaf and unit/property tests document and verify the extra `unapply_rows` path for callers that require original row order.
